description: Every device company engaged with a territory's surgeons for a family, in one answer: engagement (surgeons, depth, the Medicare cases of the surgeons it engages, the busiest the plan names), surgeons whose main company moved to it or away, new FDA clearances read as new entrant, new system or line extension, recalls on its product codes, adverse-event reports rising faster than the category, deals that changed who sells it, this week's local news that names it, the rep's own company marked yours, its knowledge card (national rank, a summary, its newest line, questions to ask), and a soWhat for this rep per company. Use it for "who is winning here", "what are my competitors doing", "what is the landscape". Give a saved territory by name (its family is used unless one is given) or a family and a place. Clearances, recalls, adverse events and switching need the coverage add-on.

cities.description: Cities within the state, to narrow it.

counties.description: 5-digit county FIPS codes forming a custom territory.

family.description: Procedure family key from coverage (e.g. knee-arthroplasty, lumbar-fusion) or a plain name.

metro.description: Metro area by name ("Charlotte") or 5-digit CBSA code (16740). Can cross state lines.

state.description: Two-letter state code, e.g. NC. Omit when giving a metro or counties.

territory.description: A saved territory's name or id from my_territories, instead of a place.

zips.description: 5-digit ZIP codes forming a custom territory (as my_territories returns them).

name: competitive_landscape
title: Competitive landscape of a territory
